sources.title: Lucasalonsoport/mixer-multitask-medium · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Mixer for Multitask. The nano configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.
